description: This file defines a servlet filter class 'AppAuthUserFilter' that intercepts HTTP requests to extract an authorization user ID from headers and sets it in a request context. It also clears the context after processing.

classes.name: AppAuthUserFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that authenticates user requests by extracting user ID from a request header and managing context.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Intercepts HTTP requests, extracts user ID from headers, logs the request, updates context, and ensures cleanup after request processing.
